items.title: Expand Energy (EXE) Agrees To Buy Twin Eagle Holdings For A Bigger Gas Platform
items.summary: Expand Energy, ticker NasdaqGS:EXE, has entered a definitive agreement to acquire Twin Eagle Holdings. The combined company is expected to form one of North America's leading integrated natural gas platforms. Management expects the transaction to be immediately accretive and to create meaningful operational synergies. items.summary: Natural gas producer Expand Energy (NASDAQ:EXE) reported Q2 CY2026 results exceeding the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 5.4% year on year to $2.96 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.33 per share was 19.1% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
